title: LEGO® Brawls
description: Build your way to the top in this lighthearted, team action brawler where anything can happen. Design your own heroic minifig with unique brawling abilities! Build ridiculous power-ups out of bricks! Work with your team to control iconic LEGO levels! Compete in 8 different arenas, including classic favorites like Castle and newcomers like Jurassic World! Expand your collection of minifigs and power-ups! Become the ultimate brawler!
